verdict.rationale: Beamer is a changelog and in-app announcement SaaS, so user-configured background automations (scheduled posts, triggered workflows) are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence shows no automation or workflow capability of Beamer's own. The HubSpot bi-directional sync, the generic "API and Webhooks" and the 3,000+ integrations are adjacent integrations or developer building blocks, not documented automations a user sets up to run on their own.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
